svg.title: Alveolus, fibrotic
svg.desc: Section through a lung alveolus in pulmonary fibrosis: septa thickened by collagen and myofibroblasts, smaller airspaces, capillaries set deeper in the septum and hyperplastic type II pneumocytes lining the alveolus.
